description: Names fix units and measurement scope. A numeric null requires an explicit unavailable reason. Censored numeric values are lower bounds, never exact durations.

attempt_elapsed_ns.description: Observed monotonic elapsed time for an attempt, including completed failure handling.

block_commit_ns.description: State commit interval, with verification excluded.

block_verify_commit_ns.description: Combined full block verification and commit interval; not pure signature verification.

block_verify_ns.description: Block verification only, with state commit excluded.

cgroup_cpu_core_equivalents.description: Cgroup CPU seconds divided by monotonic wall seconds.

cgroup_cpu_normalized_percent.description: 100 times cgroup core equivalents divided by measured effective CPU entitlement.

cgroup_cpu_ns.description: Cgroup v2 total CPU-time delta over the stated observation interval.

cgroup_memory_current_bytes.description: Cgroup v2 memory.current at one timestamp; includes more than process RSS.

cgroup_memory_peak_bytes.description: Cgroup v2 memory.peak over its recorded reset/lifetime scope; includes more than RSS.

cgroup_system_cpu_ns.description: Cgroup v2 system CPU-time delta over the stated observation interval.

cgroup_throttled_ns.description: Cgroup v2 throttled CPU-time delta; not added to used CPU time.

cgroup_throttled_periods.description: Cgroup v2 nr_throttled counter delta over the observation interval.

cgroup_user_cpu_ns.description: Cgroup v2 user CPU-time delta over the stated observation interval.

checkpoint_residence_ns.description: Checkpoint residence interval including batching and waiting.

effective_cpu_cores.description: Effective CPU entitlement from the stated affinity/quota source, not worker count.

interface_rx_bytes.description: Received byte counter delta for one named isolated interface and interval.

interface_rx_bytes_per_second.description: Interface rx byte counter delta divided by the stated monotonic wall interval.

interface_tx_bytes.description: Transmitted byte counter delta for one named isolated interface and interval.

interface_tx_bytes_per_second.description: Interface tx byte counter delta divided by the stated monotonic wall interval.

keygen_ns.description: Complete product SigningKey::from_seed public-root computation; seed preparation excluded.

mempool_bytes.description: Exact encoded bytes in the observed mempool population.

mempool_cost.description: Zakura mempool cost in bytes; distinct from encoded transaction bytes.

mempool_drain_transactions_per_second.description: Nonnegative observed reduction in mempool transaction count per second; not gross removal throughput under concurrent arrivals.

mempool_growth_bytes_per_second.description: Signed change in observed mempool bytes divided by the monotonic window.

mempool_growth_transactions_per_second.description: Signed change in observed mempool transaction count divided by the monotonic window.

mempool_queue_transactions.description: Transactions currently queued for the named admission stage.

mempool_transactions.description: Transactions currently in the observed mempool.

message_bytes.description: Verifier/signing message length before internal Pure framing.

process_cpu_core_equivalents.description: Process CPU seconds divided by monotonic wall seconds.

process_cpu_normalized_percent.description: 100 times process core equivalents divided by measured effective CPU entitlement.

process_cpu_ns.description: Process user plus system CPU-time delta over the stated observation interval.

process_peak_rss_bytes.description: Process lifetime resident-set high-water mark, including setup; never a delta.

process_system_cpu_ns.description: Process system CPU-time delta over the stated observation interval.

process_user_cpu_ns.description: Process user CPU-time delta over the stated observation interval.

propagation_admit_ns.description: Origin admission to remote admission for one transaction authorization.

propagation_origin_admit_ns.description: Origin submission to origin admission for one transaction authorization.

propagation_receive_ns.description: Origin admission to remote receipt for one transaction authorization.

proposal_verify_ns.description: Block proposal verification interval; scope and verifier route required in case metadata.

protocol_rx_bytes.description: Received encoded-protocol byte counter delta; not wire traffic.

protocol_rx_bytes_per_second.description: Protocol rx byte counter delta divided by the stated monotonic wall interval.

protocol_tx_bytes.description: Transmitted encoded-protocol byte counter delta; not wire traffic.

protocol_tx_bytes_per_second.description: Protocol tx byte counter delta divided by the stated monotonic wall interval.

rpc_elapsed_ns.description: Client monotonic elapsed time for one RPC attempt; not node admission latency.

rss_after_bytes.description: Resident process bytes at the end endpoint; not an operation peak.

rss_before_bytes.description: Resident process bytes at the start endpoint; not an operation peak.

rss_current_bytes.description: Resident process bytes at one timestamp; sampling may miss peaks.

sign_release_ns.description: Complete product sign call, including randomness and mandatory verification before release.

signature_verify_ns.description: Product signature verifier call; message and signature preparation excluded.

trace_queue_ns.description: Named queue wait interval; enqueue/dequeue event names must be recorded.

trace_residence_ns.description: Named trace residence interval; start/end event names must be recorded.

transaction_bytes.description: Exact canonical serialized transaction length, not hex or JSON length.
